shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated, evenly spaced motifs across the upper area
figural zone placed below the patterned band
schematic, outline-based figures on a coarse stone ground
justification: The most specific correspondence is the shared vertical scheme: a register of small, regularly repeated units running horizontally across the top, with larger schematic figures and long sinuous lines occupying the field beneath it, both set on a rough natural stone ground. The decisive difference is technique and content — A is a flat, broad-stroked red painting of a single abstracted human-like figure with a wheel/disc, while B is carved low relief crowded with recognisable animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake), so the manner of rendering and the density of imagery are quite unlike.
